methods.what: Change of variables x = r(1+z), y = r(1−z) to combine a product of two integrals into a double integral
Beta-integral evaluation over [-1,1] in terms of Gauss's Pi function
First moment of the beta-type weight, obtained by writing 2z = (1+z) − (1−z)
Second moment of the beta-type weight, obtained by expanding 4z^2
Riemann-invariant-type variables r, s defined through f(ρ) with f(ρ) = (2a√k/(k−1)) ρ^{(k−1)/2}
Solving for the intermediate value ρ'
